introduction: Missouri SNAP provides monthly grocery benefits through EBT. Family Support Division determines eligibility.
description: Missouri SNAP provides monthly grocery benefits through EBT. Family Support Division determines eligibility.

sections.who: Residency, household income, resources and other conditions apply. Some resources are excluded.
sections.get: The benefit depends on household size and income. SNAP food benefits cannot be withdrawn as cash.
sections.docs:
• Income and resource information.
  • Household and residency details.
  • Requested expense records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use DSS’s online or paper application.

  2. Complete any required interview

    If you miss the call, use a Resource Center or call 855-823-4908.

  3. Explain emergencies

    Complete Section 2 for expedited screening and send requested proof.
sections.after: Read the decision and reporting requirements. Use the benefit portal to check status.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using SNAP application and interview; Managing SNAP. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
